_about: Curated standardized field dictionary for SEC XBRL companyfacts data, designed from a sell-side/buy-side analyst perspective for US semiconductor & mega-cap tech equities. 'fields' map directly to XBRL tags (tried in priority order until one is present). 'derived_metrics' are computed from field keys via config-driven formulas. Fields with 'dimensional':true require XBRL axis extraction (segment/geography/product) and are NOT pulled by the basic extractor.

fields.label: Total Revenue
fields.why: Top line and the anchor for every growth, margin, and valuation multiple; also the denominator that turns dimensional segment/geo values into mix percentages.

fields.label: Cost of Revenue
fields.why: Drives gross margin; the single biggest cost line for semis and the key to pricing/mix analysis.

fields.label: Gross Profit
fields.why: Gross margin is the headline KPI for semis/hardware. Note: some filers (e.g. Alphabet) never report GrossProfit, so derive from revenue - cost_of_revenue when absent.

fields.label: Research & Development Expense
fields.why: R&D intensity is the core competitive moat metric for semis/tech; central to any thesis on innovation and operating leverage.

fields.label: Selling, General & Administrative Expense
fields.why: The combined opex line many semis report (NVDA, AVGO, MRVL); needed for operating leverage and margin bridge.

fields.label: Sales & Marketing Expense
fields.why: Platforms (GOOGL, MSFT) split S&M out; isolates demand-gen spend and go-to-market efficiency vs back-office G&A.

fields.label: General & Administrative Expense
fields.why: Reported separately by platform names; the other half of the opex split needed to reconcile to total opex.

fields.label: Total Operating Expenses
fields.why: Convenient subtotal for the opex bridge, but definition varies by filer (some include COGS), so treat with care.

fields.label: Stock-Based Compensation Expense
fields.why: Massive non-cash cost in tech/semis; sourced from the CFO add-back. Essential to adjust GAAP vs non-GAAP margins, judge dilution-adjusted profitability and FCF quality.

fields.label: Operating Income
fields.why: Operating margin is the primary profitability gauge before capital structure and tax; core to EV/EBIT and peer comparison.

fields.label: Interest Expense
fields.why: Matters for leveraged names (AVGO post-M&A); needed for coverage ratios and the bridge from operating to pretax income.

fields.label: Interest & Investment Income
fields.why: Cash-rich tech (MSFT, GOOGL, NVDA) earns material interest/investment income that inflates pretax; useful to normalize out.

fields.label: Other Non-Operating Income/(Expense), Net
fields.why: Captures FX, equity-investment gains/losses and other below-the-line noise that can swing pretax income materially.

fields.label: Pretax Income
fields.why: Income before tax is the base for effective tax rate analysis and the link from operating performance to net income.

fields.label: Income Tax Expense/(Benefit)
fields.why: Needed to compute the effective tax rate, a key swing factor in EPS and a watch item given global minimum-tax changes.

fields.label: Net Income
fields.why: Bottom-line earnings; the basis for P/E, ROE and net-margin and the most-watched headline figure.

fields.label: Net Income Available to Common Stockholders
fields.why: The true EPS numerator after preferred/NCI adjustments; differs from net income for filers like AVGO with noncontrolling interests.

fields.label: Earnings Per Share - Basic
fields.why: As-reported basic per-share earnings; primary input to trailing P/E and a sanity check on the income statement.

fields.label: Earnings Per Share - Diluted
fields.why: The headline EPS for valuation; captures dilution from RSUs/options, which is large in SBC-heavy tech.

fields.label: Dividends Declared Per Share
fields.why: Drives dividend yield and payout ratio; coverage is uneven (NVDA token, GOOGL/META only began 2024, MU/AVGO/MRVL pay) so may be zero/absent.

fields.label: Weighted Avg Shares Outstanding - Basic
fields.why: Basic denominator for per-share math and tracking buyback-driven share shrink.

fields.label: Weighted Avg Shares Outstanding - Diluted
fields.why: Diluted denominator behind diluted EPS; essential for modeling dilution and reconciling EPS to net income.

fields.label: Common Shares Outstanding (DEI cover)
fields.why: Point-in-time share count from the cover page (dei taxonomy); denominator for current market cap. Multi-class issuers (GOOGL, META) report per class via dimensions, so the plain tag may undercount total shares.

fields.label: Reportable Segment Revenue
fields.why: The single biggest thesis driver (NVDA Data Center, AVGO Semiconductor Solutions, GOOGL Cloud, MSFT Intelligent Cloud) — shows where growth and mix shift come from. Exists only as dimensional XBRL data (StatementBusinessSegmentsAxis), not a plain tag.

fields.label: Reportable Segment Operating Income
fields.why: Segment profitability reveals which businesses fund the company and is essential for sum-of-the-parts valuation. Dimensional only (segment axis).

fields.label: Revenue by Product vs Service
fields.why: Product/service split (MSFT product vs service, AVGO products vs subscriptions) separates one-time hardware from recurring software/cloud, a key durability signal. Dimensional (ProductOrServiceAxis).

fields.label: Revenue by Geography
fields.why: Geographic mix (China/Taiwan/US exposure) drives demand cyclicality and export-control risk, highly material for semis and directly relevant to Taiwanese investors. Dimensional only (geography axis).

fields.label: Long-Lived Assets by Geography
fields.why: Geographic asset footprint flags supply-chain concentration and capex location, complementing geographic revenue for country-risk assessment. Dimensional only.

fields.label: Remaining Performance Obligations (Backlog)
fields.why: RPO is the cleanest forward-revenue indicator for platform/software names (MSFT, GOOGL Cloud, AVGO software) — contracted future revenue not yet recognized.

fields.label: Cash & Cash Equivalents
fields.why: The most liquid asset and the starting point for net-cash/net-debt and runway analysis.

fields.label: Short-Term Investments / Marketable Securities (Current)
fields.why: Cash-like liquidity held in marketable securities; combined with cash to gauge true liquidity and net cash.

fields.label: Long-Term / Non-Current Marketable Securities
fields.why: Non-current marketable securities that still represent monetizable liquidity for cash-rich tech names.

fields.label: Accounts Receivable, Net (Current)
fields.why: Drives DSO and working-capital quality; spikes can signal channel stuffing or collection risk.

fields.label: Inventory, Net
fields.why: Vital for semis: rising inventory and falling turns flag demand softening, obsolescence and future write-downs.

fields.label: Total Current Assets
fields.why: Numerator of the current ratio and basis for net working capital.

fields.label: Property, Plant & Equipment, Net
fields.why: Capital intensity and asset base; for semis/AI buildouts PP&E growth tracks fab and data-center capex.

fields.label: Goodwill
fields.why: M&A-driven (huge for AVGO/MRVL); impairment risk and a key adjustment for tangible book value.

fields.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Excl. Goodwill)
fields.why: Acquired IP/customer relationships; amortization drags GAAP earnings and adjusts tangible equity.

fields.label: Total Assets
fields.why: Denominator for ROA and asset-turnover; the balance-sheet footing and leverage base.

fields.label: Accounts Payable (Current)
fields.why: Drives DPO and the cash conversion cycle; supplier financing of operations.

fields.label: Total Current Liabilities
fields.why: Denominator of current/quick ratios and basis for net working capital.

fields.label: Short-Term / Current Portion of Debt
fields.why: Near-term refinancing/maturity wall; combined with long-term debt for total leverage and net debt.

fields.label: Commercial Paper
fields.why: Short-term funding many of these issuers tap; separate visibility into rollover/liquidity risk.

fields.label: Long-Term Debt (Non-Current)
fields.why: Core solvency metric; basis for net debt, debt/EBITDA and interest-coverage analysis.

fields.label: Deferred / Contract Revenue (Current)
fields.why: Booked-but-unrecognized revenue; a leading demand signal and quality-of-revenue indicator for subscription/cloud businesses.

fields.label: Deferred / Contract Revenue (Non-Current)
fields.why: Longer-dated contracted backlog (multi-year enterprise/cloud commitments), indicating revenue visibility beyond 12 months.

fields.label: Total Liabilities
fields.why: Total obligations; debt-to-assets and the complement of equity in the leverage picture.

fields.label: Total Stockholders' Equity (parent)
fields.why: Book value of the firm; denominator for ROE, BVPS and debt-to-equity, basis for P/B. Prefer the parent-only StockholdersEquity tag over the NCI-inclusive variant for BVPS.

fields.label: Cash Flow from Operations (CFO)
fields.why: The single most important cash flow line; the cash engine funding capex, buybacks and dividends and the base of FCF.

fields.label: Capital Expenditures (Capex)
fields.why: Drives FCF and signals AI/datacenter and fab investment intensity, the central capital-allocation debate for these names.

fields.label: Cash Flow from Investing (CFI)
fields.why: Captures total investing outflows beyond capex (acquisitions, securities) and ties the three-section cash bridge together.

fields.label: Cash Flow from Financing (CFF)
fields.why: Shows net effect of buybacks, dividends and debt; reveals whether the company is returning capital or raising it.

fields.label: Share Repurchases (Buybacks)
fields.why: Primary capital-return lever for MSFT/GOOGL/META/AVGO/NVDA; key to per-share growth and total shareholder yield.

fields.label: Depreciation & Amortization (D&A)
fields.why: Largest non-cash add-back, reflects past capex flowing through the P&L; needed to reconcile earnings to cash and assess capital intensity.

fields.label: Dividends Paid
fields.why: Committed cash return; combined with buybacks gives total shareholder yield (MU/AVGO pay, NVDA token, META/GOOGL only recently initiated).

fields.label: Acquisitions, Net of Cash Acquired
fields.why: M&A is a major capital-allocation channel for AVGO/MRVL and swings CFI; useful for separating organic vs inorganic strategy.

fields.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Debt
fields.why: Shows leverage build, especially relevant for AVGO's acquisition-financed balance sheet.

fields.label: Repayments of Debt
fields.why: Tracks deleveraging pace alongside debt issuance to gauge net financing posture.

derived_metrics.label: Gross Profit (derived fallback)
derived_metrics.why: Some filers (e.g. Alphabet) never report GrossProfit, so it must be computed from revenue minus cost of revenue.

derived_metrics.label: Gross Margin %
derived_metrics.why: The single most-watched profitability gauge in semis; reflects pricing power, mix, and fab/process cost leverage.

derived_metrics.label: Operating Margin %
derived_metrics.why: Captures operating leverage after R&D and SG&A, the core efficiency story for both semis and platforms.

derived_metrics.label: Net Margin %
derived_metrics.why: Bottom-line profitability after tax and below-the-line items; needed to bridge to EPS and ROE.

derived_metrics.label: Effective Tax Rate
derived_metrics.why: Standardizes tax burden across companies/periods, flags one-off tax items, and feeds NOPAT/ROIC.

derived_metrics.label: R&D Intensity (R&D / Revenue)
derived_metrics.why: R&D is the lifeblood of semis competitiveness; intensity reveals reinvestment rate and node/architecture commitment.

derived_metrics.label: Stock-Based Comp % of Revenue
derived_metrics.why: SBC is large at big-tech/semis and dilutes shareholders; sizing it vs revenue checks earnings quality and true margins.

derived_metrics.label: Capex Intensity (Capex / Revenue)
derived_metrics.why: Distinguishes asset-heavy fab/datacenter builders from fabless designers and signals capital cycle position.

derived_metrics.label: Free Cash Flow (FCF)
derived_metrics.why: The cash actually available to return or reinvest; the headline valuation input (FCF yield, DCF), not reported as a single XBRL tag.

derived_metrics.label: FCF Margin %
derived_metrics.why: Normalizes cash generation against revenue, the cleanest cross-peer cash-efficiency comparison.

derived_metrics.label: Net Working Capital
derived_metrics.why: Operating liquidity buffer and a driver of free cash flow swings, especially for inventory-heavy semis.

derived_metrics.label: Total Debt
derived_metrics.why: Aggregate borrowings for leverage ratios; combines current and long-term debt across varying tags.

derived_metrics.label: Net Debt (Net Cash)
derived_metrics.why: The headline solvency figure; most of these tech/semis names sit in net cash, central to EV and the thesis.

derived_metrics.label: Tangible Book Value
derived_metrics.why: Equity stripped of goodwill/intangibles; a conservative book-value floor for heavily acquisitive names.

derived_metrics.label: Book Value Per Share
derived_metrics.why: Equity per share for price-to-book screening; weak for asset-light/buyback-heavy tech (can go negative) so treat as context, not a hard floor.

derived_metrics.label: Days Inventory Outstanding (DIO)
derived_metrics.why: Critical cyclical signal in semis; rising DIO flags demand softening and looming write-downs/margin pressure.

derived_metrics.label: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)
derived_metrics.why: Tracks receivables quality and channel/customer health; spikes can presage revenue-recognition or collection risk.

derived_metrics.label: Return on Equity
derived_metrics.why: Headline capital-efficiency metric; for buyback-heavy big-tech it captures returns net of shareholder returns.

derived_metrics.label: Return on Assets
derived_metrics.why: Efficiency of the total asset base, useful for comparing fab-heavy vs fabless and asset-light platform models.

derived_metrics.label: Return on Invested Capital
derived_metrics.why: The truest test of value creation vs cost of capital; key for capital-intensive semis with heavy reinvestment.

derived_metrics.label: Revenue YoY Growth %
derived_metrics.why: Top-line momentum is the primary driver of the thesis and multiple in this growth-sensitive peer group (compare same fiscal period YoY).

derived_metrics.label: Diluted EPS YoY Growth %
derived_metrics.why: Captures earnings power growth net of dilution, the input to PEG and forward valuation.

derived_metrics.label: YoY Diluted Share Count Change
derived_metrics.why: Net buyback vs dilution signal; for these mega-caps SBC-driven dilution vs repurchase is a real per-share thesis driver.

derived_metrics.label: Total Deferred Revenue
derived_metrics.why: Combining current and noncurrent gives one comparable demand-pipeline figure across companies that report the split differently.

derived_metrics.label: Segment Revenue Mix %
derived_metrics.why: Normalizing each segment to total revenue is how analysts track mix shift (e.g. NVDA Data Center share rising toward ~90%) across periods and companies; depends on dimensional segment_revenue.

notes: DIMENSIONAL FIELDS (harder to extract): segment_revenue, segment_operating_income, product_service_revenue, geographic_revenue and long_lived_assets_by_geography do NOT exist as plain top-level tags. They live as breakdowns of a base tag (e.g. RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax / OperatingIncomeLoss / Revenues) qualified by an XBRL axis member: StatementBusinessSegmentsAxis (segments), ProductOrServiceAxis (product vs service), and the geography axes (srt:StatementGeographicalAxis / EntityWideDisclosure geographic tags). Extraction must iterate the dimensioned facts and read the member labels, and segment/member naming is company-specific and changes when companies re-segment, so cross-company and cross-time alignment requires a manual mapping layer. The derived metric segment_revenue_mix_pct depends on these dimensional values.

TAG-CONFLICT / DEDUP RESOLUTIONS: (1) revenue and total_revenue proposals were merged into one 'revenue' field with the union of tags in priority order (RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax first, then Revenues, IncludingAssessedTax, SalesRevenueNet); this same field is the denominator for all mix and margin ratios. (2) stock_based_compensation was proposed by both the income-statement and cash-flow lenses with identical tags (ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense) — kept once and assigned statement=cash_flow since the CFO add-back is the most consistently populated location. (3) gross_profit is a raw field but kept gross_profit_derived as a separate derived fallback because filers like Alphabet omit the GrossProfit tag entirely — pick the reported tag when present, else compute. (4) eps_basic/eps_diluted and the weighted_avg_shares_* fields were proposed by two lenses; merged with the union of tags, adding IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPer*Share and WeightedAverageNumberOfShareOutstandingBasicAndDiluted as fallbacks. (5) shares_outstanding_dei and shares_outstanding merged into one dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding field. (6) total_stockholders_equity and stockholders_equity merged; prefer the parent-only StockholdersEquity tag over the NCI-inclusive variant for BVPS/ROE. (7) Duplicate derived metrics (effective_tax_rate, fcf/free_cash_flow, net_cash/net_debt) were each consolidated to a single definition; total_debt is defined as a derived intermediate so net_debt and roic reference it consistently.

VALUATION INPUTS NOT SOURCEABLE FROM SEC: share price, market capitalization, enterprise value (EV), P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA, FCF yield and dividend yield all require live/market price data, which XBRL/companyfacts does NOT contain. These must be built in the app by combining the SEC per-share fundamentals here (eps_diluted, book_value_per_share, dividends_per_share, shares_outstanding, free_cash_flow, net_debt) with an external market-data feed. No XBRL tag exists for them, so the original 'market_valuation_inputs_external' placeholder was intentionally dropped from the field list and recorded here instead.

SNDK (SanDisk) HISTORY GAP: SanDisk only has standalone SEC filings since its February 2025 spin-off from Western Digital (WDC). Its companyfacts will contain at most a few quarters of independent 10-Q/10-K data, so the ~3-year history target and all YoY growth metrics (revenue_yoy_growth, eps_yoy_growth, diluted_share_count_change) will be sparse or unavailable for SNDK until enough post-spin periods accumulate; pre-2025 figures, if needed, must be reconstructed from WDC carve-out disclosures outside companyfacts.

PERIOD/COMPARABILITY MECHANICS: when pulling points, filter on form (10-K vs 10-Q) and use fy/fp plus the frame field to select the right period; 10-Q points are quarterly (or YTD for some duration tags) while 10-K are annual, so YoY derived metrics must compare the SAME fiscal period (use t vs t-4 quarters for quarterly series). Multi-class issuers (GOOGL Class A/B/C, META Class A/B) report dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding per class via dimensions, so the undimensioned cover-page share count can undercount total shares — sum the class members for an accurate market-cap denominator.

Field count: 55 raw fields and 26 derived metrics. The raw set is slightly above the 35-55 target because several dimensional breakdowns (segment/geo/product) and dual-reporting opex lines (SG&A split into S&M + G&A for platforms) are retained to support both the semis and the mega-cap-platform peer groups in one schema; all are honestly priced by priority so the app can default to core-only views.
